dialogues.speaker: Kousaka
dialogues.text: Seriously, though, what are these "fan novel" things?

dialogues.speaker: Kousaka
dialogues.text: Every time I ask the people around here, I get dirty looks. What's with that?

dialogues.speaker: Kousaka
dialogues.text: Also, I've been listening to the discussions between people in the queues, and while I recognize every word they say, the sentences that are formed make no sense to me...
